'''Hanx-Wargel''' was a [[Computer/Legends|computer]] manufacturing company. They developed [[SuperFlow II]] and later the [[SuperFlow IV/Legends|SuperFlow IV]] computer for use in starships. The control functions of the [[Millennium Falcon/Legends|''Millennium Falcon'']] were originally controlled by a SuperFlow IV computer before being extensively modified and rebuilt.<ref name="SWS" />
